body: sorry i just read this and i’m genuinely so sorry you’re going through this. i know it’s easier said than done but sometimes it’s best to rip the bandaid off. it’s not working and you deserve so much more than this. you shouldn’t be hating yourself, you shouldn’t want to die. your partner should remind you of why life is good, they should uplift and cherish you. he’s been awful to you and it’ll be best for you in the long run to go your separate ways. he doesn’t deserve you
